bullets: Updated the free-mode country allowlist to use shared tier constants for the landing FAQ and full-access plan pools.
Preserved full-access allowances for subscribers in Singapore and Israel after their countries moved to limited access on September 15, 2026.
Added a desktop foundation-backend mode and a storage intent angle so desktop app users can see sponsored file-storage recommendations alongside database and auth suggestions.
Added web and cli-login values to the post-signup questionnaire surface choices so command-line and desktop browser submissions can be distinguished from dashboard pop-up forms.
Rewrote BYOK requests to Luna and OpenRouter OpenAI endpoints so the SDK can drop or rename unsupported fields per endpoint during generation and streaming.
Added sponsored proposal refresh polling that only runs while the proposal window is visible and its thread is the active foreground thread.
Added read-only Supabase setup invitation schemas and capability contracts, marked non-billable and not a sponsored-execution capability.
Bumped the Supabase setup invitation capability schema to version 2 so new invitations require recognizable third-party provider packages rather than older incomplete evidence.
Generalized three advertiser reason codes into a single context-filtered explanation shown to advertisers when their ads are held back.
Added command-scoped click ID support to sponsored procedure inputs so opaque bfcid attribution can be appended when an advertiser link is present.
Added forecast and coverage status fields to the subscription cost report page while keeping the existing daily run-rate estimate.
Added a v3 Supabase setup invitation capability and v2 discovery card so Mac and Linux desktop users can be shown offers with lighter project checks.
Kept the last known subscription cost snapshot visible even when the background refresh is interrupted, showing its timestamp and next refresh time.
